title: Keep every plan artifact valid against its package-shipped schema

facts.note: Plan artifacts live in the planning tree; recognized by path/file kind.
Each recognized artifact kind maps to a JSON Schema in planner-schemas/. Applies to every recognized artifact present, whether new, edited or unchanged.
Vendored and generated trees are never scanned (source exception).
Schema-violation findings come from the planner_schema_validation validator; it reports them under this rule or under the owning canonical rule (routing only, not an applicability exclusion).

fires: A planner creates or edits a wagon, feature, WMBT (with its acceptances), train, train interlocking, journey topology or registry file.
Plan validation runs over a repository containing existing, unchanged recognized plan artifacts.
A recognized plan artifact fails its JSON Schema, including violations that are reported under a canonical rule such as planner.train.naming.
doesNotFire: Files under node_modules, dist, build or _generated.
Files that are not a recognized plan artifact kind.

given: A recognized plan artifact (wagon, feature, WMBT and its acceptances, train, train interlocking, journey topology, registry) outside vendored/generated trees — new, edited or already present
when: The planner authors or edits plan artifacts, or plan validation runs over the repository
then: Every such artifact satisfies its JSON Schema in `planner-schemas/`.
prefer: Correct the field the finding names, as the schema requires.
Check the artifact's schema in `planner-schemas/` before adding or renaming fields.
avoid: Leaving a schema violation in place on the assumption that downstream rules will tolerate it — they assume the schema shape and break silently.
Editing or loosening the package-shipped schema to make an artifact pass.
unless: Vendored and generated trees (`node_modules`, `dist`, `build`, `_generated`) are never scanned.
why: The schemas are the shape every other rule assumes. An artifact that breaks its schema breaks those assumptions silently.
evidence: The planner_schema_validation validator, run over all recognized plan artifacts in the repository (not only changed ones), reports no schema violations — neither under atdd-bun.planner.schema nor under the canonical rule a violation is routed to.
Each finding is fixed by correcting the named field as the schema requires.
verifier_detail: Validate every recognized plan artifact (wagon, feature, WMBT and its acceptances, train, train interlocking, journey topology, registries) against its JSON Schema in `planner-schemas/`, regardless of whether it changed.

Routing: a violation that belongs to a canonical rule is reported under that rule (for example `planner.train.naming`); every other violation is reported under atdd-bun.planner.schema (catch-all). Routing decides attribution only; the artifact is still required to conform.

Validator prerequisite (from graph requires edge): schema validation operates on a parsed document, so parsing (atdd-bun.planner.parse) runs first. A parse failure is not an exemption from schema conformity; the artifact must both parse and conform.
audit: schema_version 1.1.0; kind rule; status active; introduced_in 0.1.0.

Package rule, strict. Term package_rule: a rule of this package's own gates (`atdd-bun.*`), realized by a package guard rather than a canonical planner node. It is held to the same per-rule checks as every convention: a convention, strict, a failing fixture, relationship edges.
Summary: Plan artifacts satisfy their package-shipped schema.

sharedNodes.text: Strict disposition: fails on every finding, no advisory mode, no ratchet baseline.

additions.text: Editing or loosening the package-shipped schema to make an artifact pass.
additions.justification: Metric-gaming anti-pattern implied by 'package-shipped schema' being the fixed reference; authoring rules require naming gaming moves.

additions.text: Check the artifact's schema in `planner-schemas/` before adding or renaming fields.
additions.justification: Concrete planner move derived from the statement; makes the obligation actionable at authoring time.

additions.text: Parsing (atdd-bun.planner.parse) runs before schema validation; parse failure is not an exemption.
additions.justification: Taken from graph.json requires edge, not from the source; stated as a validator prerequisite, not an applicability exclusion.

additions.text: 'or plan validation runs over the repository' and 'new, edited or already present' in given.
additions.justification: Makes explicit the source's universal scope ('Every recognized plan artifact'), so unchanged artifacts are covered; not a new obligation.

trace.note: Routing of findings only; does not narrow applicability.
Meta-requirement on package rules' own convention artifacts, not a planner decision.
